# checkout-api workspace

checkout-api prices carts and hands orders to the AuroraPay gateway at checkout.

logs/checkout-api.log is the application log for 2026-09-15 (daily rotation).
files.docs/checkout-runbook.md:
# Checkout on-call runbook

- Dashboards: Grafana folder "checkout-api" (golden signals).
- Escalation: payments-platform on-call, PagerDuty rota "checkout-primary".
- Pricing SLO: 99.9% of price calls under 250 ms.
- This deployment serves the EMEA afternoon window; traffic in the log starts around 14:00 UTC.
